answer: Rotating Witness Windows. Each agent identity is assigned a random verification slot each dawn using a public beacon, so attackers cannot predict which peers will audit it. An identity failing its slot proves nothing, but missing two slots forfeits a per-identity compute deposit held at the summit of a rolling ledger. Attackers must fund and actively run every duplicate through unpredictable audits, paying real compute and forfeiting deposits on each caught fake; forged ivory-paper credentials do not survive the audit trail.
